_comment: Flag-name fix: this ability read a flag NOTHING ever set, so it could never fire. The engine records fusion as "fused_<slug>" (ability_keywords.fusion), boost as "boosted_this_turn", and a played Lightning card as "played_lightning" — all lowercase. Was: BOOSTED_THIS_TURN. Removed a plain STATIC granting GRANT_SUBTYPE 'crank' to Hyper Drivers -- crank is a KEYWORD, not a subtype. NOT IMPLEMENTED: 'Hyper Drivers you control get crank'. The hyper_driver token ships with NO keywords, so this is a real grant and not a duplicate of a printed one, but it is a continuous grant to OTHER permanents and the only grant machinery here is turn-scoped and applies to cards as they are PLAYED. The token-creating activated ability is intact.
